vectorSchema.id: Stable vector identifier (e.g. v001). Never reused.
vectorSchema.description: Human-readable label for the test case.
vectorSchema.secretB64: Input keying material passed as secretB64 to the encoder.
vectorSchema.policy: Normalised PasswordPolicy object (all fields present, camelCase).
vectorSchema.accountId: Site account identifier string (may be empty).
vectorSchema.expected: The exact password string the encoder must produce.
vectorSchema.reject: If true, expected is intentionally wrong; both TS and Rust must produce a DIFFERENT value.

notes: Vectors generated from passwordPolicy.ts at commit fd00014 (mobile-dev branch).
Algorithm: upspa-password-encoding-v2 (SHA-256 block-counter expansion, NOT HKDF).
v022 is the deliberately mutated rejection vector.
